description: Fork of exp513 (qk nap=4/tph=256, NO v-branch, v_lut nap=6/tph=320 = 1.4825). ONLY change: v_lut tph 320->256 at fixed nap=6 (2^nap*tph: 64*320=20480 -> 64*256=16384; v_lut params 1.97M->1.57M, -2.36M total -> 87.03M). Tests the v_lut tph dimension at its preferred depth nap=6 -- can v_lut be smaller (tph 320->256) without hurting? vs exp513 1.4825 (tph320), exp525 1.4843 (nap8), exp524 1.5055 (nap4).
